snippet.title: I gave an AI access to my code. It ships a conversion fix every week.
snippet.description:
Your site is leaking signups every week — and you can't see where. So I connected an AI growth agent to my code.

Every week it:
→ reads your real analytics + code and finds your single biggest conversion leak
→ writes the fix as a real GitHub pull request (or a staged Shopify edit)
→ sends it to Telegram — you reply YES and it ships, never before
→ measures for 48h and proposes a rollback if a fix ever hurts your numbers

One conversion fix, every week, shipped with your approval. No dashboard of to-dos you still have to build yourself.

14-day free trial, no card → https://velyr.io
